response.sql: WITH album_stats AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) as avg_unit_price, CAST(SUM(Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(Milliseconds) as bytes_per_ms FROM Track WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds > 0 GROUP BY AlbumId), overall_avg AS (SELECT CAST(SUM(Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(Milliseconds) as overall_bpm FROM Track WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds > 0) SELECT a.AlbumId, a.avg_unit_price, a.bytes_per_ms, a.bytes_per_ms - o.overall_bpm as difference FROM album_stats a CROSS JOIN overall_avg o ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
